propertySets.name: Pset_CableCarrierSegmentTypeDropper
propertySets.definition: Properties that are applicable to a type or an occurrence of dropper.

properties.name: CurrentCarryingCapacity
properties.definition: Maximum value of electric current which can be carried continuously by a conductor, a device or an apparatus, under specified conditions without its steady-state temperature exceeding a  specified value. Based on IEC60826-11-13. NOTE: The temperature specified value is maximum Design Ambient Temperature.

properties.name: TensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the ability to withstand breakage apart under applied force.

properties.name: AssemblyInstruction
properties.definition: Instructions to describe how the system / equipment / facility is assembled.

properties.name: IsRigid
properties.definition: Indication of whether the conduit is rigid (= TRUE) or flexible (= FALSE).

properties.name: UltimateTensileStrength
properties.definition: Indicates the maximum stress that a material or element can withstand before breaking while being stretched or pulled.

properties.name: IsAdjustable
properties.definition: Indicates whether the element is adjustable or not.

properties.name: IsCurrentCarrying
properties.definition: To indicate whether the current will go through the dropper.

properties.name: NominalLoad
properties.definition: The nominal load that a component can support.
